🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Good weekend picks for the neighborhood—something for everyone.

🧑‍🌾 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Fresh local produce, coffee, and community vibe.
❄️ *Sat 2 PM* — Disney's Frozen - The Broadway Musical at the Santa Clarita Performing Arts Center
   Kids love Frozen—a Broadway-level treat this weekend.
🎭 *Fri 7 PM* — Coriolanus presented by Santa Clarita Shakespeare 2026 Festival (free)
   Free Shakespeare under the stars, great for culture.
🎵 *Sat 7 PM* — Concerts in the Park, presented by Logix Federal Credit Union: Top 40 Country
   Live country music in the park with the family.
🐑 *Sun* — Visit The Gentle Barn (from $15)
   Kids can meet animals; peaceful weekend activity.
🎸 *Sun 1 PM* — Afternoon Acoustic Jam (free)
   Acoustic jam for adults who want live local music.
🎪 *Sun 2 PM* — Coriolanus presented by Santa Clarita Shakespeare 2026 Festival (free)
   Another chance to catch the free Shakespeare matinee.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
